items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown, not certification. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS safety. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible work that maintains existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Do not dispatch, requeue, deploy, add dependencies, access credentials, change permissions, or expand exposure.

Retain the proposed 0xroulette.com performance work and allthingsmasonic.com disclosure audit as deferred or evidence-only backlog. Their scopes are reversible and do not independently create a security blocker, but neither is queue-eligible until existing ownership, release, measurement, failure-repair, attribution, rollback, and security gates are evidenced. Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only; record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns without accessing credentials, private containers, permissions, configuration, or production.
